item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
Upcoming public meetings and notable government actions in Bentonville on August 11 through August 26.
Upcoming public meetings. City of Bentonville meetings and agendas: Finance Committee Aug 11; Combined Committee of the Whole and City Council Aug 11; Board of Adjustments Aug 12 (no agenda); Planning Commission Aug 18; Utility Board Aug 18; Tree and Landscape Committee Aug 20 (no agenda); Public Art Advisory Board Aug 20 (no agenda); Finance Committee Aug 25; Combined Committee of the Whole and City Council Aug 25; Board of Adjustments Aug 26.
Heat advisory. NWS issued a Heat Advisory for Benton County until August 9 at 8:00 PM CDT, with heat index values up to 108 expected Sunday.
Northwest Arkansas growth and business briefs. Local business owners report growth challenges and opportunities; highlights include Taziki’s Rogers opening and Simmons Foods executive promotions.
Fayetteville cooling centers and community updates. Fayetteville confirmed cooling center locations for August 8–16 and received resident feedback leading to extended hours.
Burn ban and weather-related advisories. Two River Valley counties under burn ban during moderate wildfire risk; ongoing high heat impacts Benton County.
Infrastructure and development notes. Multiple departments coordinated response to a shop fire; Northwest Arkansas Community College announces new dean; study names Benton County as a candidate for future nuclear development.
